notes.title: Trials of Kokoro is Released!
notes.notes:
Trials of Kokoro, my second game, is now available for purchase! Join Aedric as he fights to reclaim himself, and experience the emotional journey that he faces along the way. In this Visual Novel RPG, exciting turn-based battles merge with a gripping narrative about facing one's past, the meaning of family, and the loss of innocence.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1972640/Trials_of_Kokoro/

notes.title: Trials of Kokoro's Demo has been updated!!
notes.notes:
Trials of Kokoro's demo has been updated with a lot of new content!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1972640/Trials_of_Kokoro/

The game now contains -

[list]
[*] Official title page graphic
[*] Tutorials that help explain aspects of the game, complete with pictures
[*] More gems added for further customization. Some are dropped, but others must be stolen!
[*] Custom icons for all stats, items, skills, and spells
[*] Ability to fast forward through all non-battle dialogue if desired
[*] Updates to enemy balancing. Now, all enemies carry one item that can be stolen!
[*] Aedric's official theme has been added to the game!
[/list]

Trials of Kokoro is a turn-based RPG, focusing on party management, including skill and equipment upgrades, item management, and customizeable builds. Guide Aedric, Rhea, and Athena on their adventure in the wilds of the mysterious country of Hinode. The demo spans roughly 2.5 hours of content, and will comprise a big part of the first act.

The storyline is emotional and is told like a visual novel, focusing on themes of personal identity, facing one's past, and accepting oneself.

Access the demo by clicking the [b]Download Demo[/b] button on the right side of the page, about halfway down.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/BhMWBcB.png[/img]

notes.notes:
TD Games' second release is ready for wishlisting! [i]Trials of Kokoro[/i] is a turn-based game that fuses party and inventory management, strategic battles, and an intriguing story.

notes.title: Difficulty Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I've received some incredibly helpful feedback about the game, and have decided to adjust the game's balancing in turn. Student, the game's normal difficulty has been heavily adjusted to be more fair, and I think it'll be much more rewarding to play now. Journeyman and Wind Adept difficulties are still present for those that want to be challenged, but now a new difficulty, Storyteller, has been added. In this difficulty, the heroes will gain great bonuses and resistances. This mode trivializes combat and is great for players that want to solely focus on the game's story, lore, and characters.

Have a great weekend, friends, and I hope you enjoy this update.

All the best,
T

notes.title: Trials of Guinevere released!
notes.notes:
After much time and hard work, Trials of Guinevere is now available for purchase.

Join Lane and his friends as they are thrust into a city-wide calamity that uproots their lives. Trials of Guinevere features turn-based, tactical combat, as well as a storyline inspired by visual novels. Your decisions matter in this adventure, and only two of the main heroes are guaranteed to survive!
